_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Spot is rangebound (BTC 30d flat, F&G mid-coil, funding quiet); extremes are latent not active, so the statistically honest base rate is HOLD one rung up only if the band holds.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicitly HOLD→Complacency; narrative implies caution via skew but does not contradict the coil/HOLD path
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed holds 47-54 and BTC stays rangebound with no ETF-flow or funding impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed leaves 39-62 on a price break (liquidation flush under 39 or ETF-flow reversal through 62)
